1.def: Past Continuous — o'tmishdagi ma'lum bir paytda DAVOM ETAYOTGAN ish: «-ayotgan edim». Ish o'sha lahzada hali tugamagan bo'ladi.
uses: O'tmishdagi aniq paytda davom etgan ish
At eight I was having dinner.
The sun was shining and birds were singing.
I was sleeping when you called.
1.tip: O'tmishdagi suratni tasavvur qiling: surat olingan paytda nima qilinayotgan edi?
rules: I, he, she, it → was; we, you, they → were.
know, like, want kabi holat fe'llari Continuous bo'lmaydi.
Tugagan qisqa ish uchun Past Simple.
ex: What were you doing at six?

2.def: Ikki zamon birga: Past Continuous — davom etayotgan UZUN ish, Past Simple — uni bo'lgan yoki shu paytda yuz bergan QISQA voqea.
uses: I was cooking when the phone rang.
Ikki ish bir vaqtda davom etadi
While I was cooking, he was reading.
The phone rang and I answered it.
forms: S + was / were + V-ing + when + Past Simple
We were walking when it started to rain.
While she was singing, he was dancing.
He came in and sat down.
rules: while dan keyin odatda Continuous keladi.
when I arrived, he was eating — kelganimda ovqatlanayotgan edi.
when I arrived, he ate — kelganimdan keyin ovqatlandi.
Gap while / when bilan boshlansa, vergul qo'yiladi.
ex: I saw an accident while I was waiting.
When you called, I was having a shower.
Qo'ng'iroq qilganingda dush qabul qilayotgan edim.
She fell while she was running.
err: While I cooked, the phone was ringing.
While I was cooking, the phone rang.
I walked home when I was seeing him.
I was walking home when I saw him.

3.def: used to — o'tmishda muntazam bo'lgan, lekin HOZIR YO'Q odat yoki holat: «ilgari …ar edim».
uses: There used to be a cinema here.
Did you use to live there?
forms: She used to have long hair.
I didn't use to like milk.
3.tip: used to = «oldin shunday edi, endi unday emas».
rules: did bor joyda use (d harfisiz).
Hozirgi odat uchun used to emas, usually.
Bir marta bo'lgan ish uchun Past Simple.
ex: My father used to walk to work.
I didn't use to drink coffee, but now I do.
This used to be a quiet street.
err: I use to play when I was five.
I used to play when I was five.
Did you used to go there?
Did you use to go there?

4.def: Present Perfect — o'tmishdagi ishni HOZIR bilan bog'laydi: ish bo'lgan, lekin QACHONligi muhim emas, natijasi yoki tajribasi hozir muhim.
uses: We have lived here for a year.
4.tip: O'zbekcha «-ganman» ko'pincha Present Perfect: ko'rganman — I have seen.
rules: he, she, it → has; qolganlari → have.
To'g'ri fe'llarda V3 = V-ed; noto'g'rilarda alohida: see → seen, go → gone.
yesterday, ago, last week bilan ishlatilmaydi.

5.def: ever (hech, biror marta) va never (hech qachon) Present Perfect bilan hayotiy TAJRIBA haqida gaplashadi: butun umringiz davomida bo'lganmi.
uses: Have you ever ridden a horse?
I have never seen the sea.
forms: Yes, S + have. ; No, S + haven't.
5.tip: Savol ever bilan Perfect'da boshlanadi, tafsilot esa Past Simple'da davom etadi.
rules: never bilan not qo'shilmaydi.
ever va never V3 dan oldin turadi.
been to — borib kelgan; gone to — ketgan, hali qaytmagan.
ex: Have you ever been to Samarkand?
Yes, I have. I went there in May.
err: He has gone to Paris twice.
He has been to Paris twice.

6.def: just — hozirgina, already — allaqachon, yet — hali / -mi. Uchalasi ham Present Perfect bilan ishlatilib, ish hozirgacha bajarilgan-bajarilmaganini ko'rsatadi.
6.tip: yet doim gapning oxirida kutib turadi.
rules: yet darak gapda ishlatilmaydi.
already savolda hayratni bildiradi: Have you finished already?
just va already have / has bilan V3 orasida.
ex: Have you seen the new film yet?

7.def: for va since ish qachondan beri davom etayotganini ko'rsatadi. for — QANCHA VAQT (davomiylik), since — QACHONDAN (boshlanish nuqtasi).
uses: I have lived here for five years.
How long have you known her?
forms: S + have / has + V3 + for + davr
He has been ill for a week.
S + have / has + V3 + since + nuqta
She has worked here since May.
How long + have / has + S + V3?
How long have you had this car?
7.tip: Soatni hisoblasangiz — for. Taqvimdagi nuqtani ko'rsatsangiz — since.
rules: Hozirgacha davom etayotgan holat uchun Present Simple emas, Perfect.
since dan keyin gap kelsa, odatda Past Simple: since I moved.
How long are you here? — qancha qolasiz (boshqa ma'no).
ex: We've been married for ten years.
I haven't seen him since Friday.
How long has she been a teacher?
err: I live here for two years.
I have lived here for two years.

8.def: Present Perfect — qachonligi aytilmagan, hozirga aloqador ish. Past Simple — qachon bo'lgani ANIQ, tugagan ish.
8.tip: Gapda «qachon» javobi bormi? Bor — Past Simple.
rules: When …? savoli doim Past Simple.
Tugagan davr (last month) — Past; tugamagan davr (this month) — Perfect.
Suhbat ko'pincha Perfect bilan boshlanib, Past bilan davom etadi.
ex: I've seen this film. I saw it in June.
err: I have seen her last night.

9.def: will — kelasi zamon: gapirayotgan paytda qabul qilingan qaror, bashorat, va'da va taklif.
uses: I'm cold. I'll close the window.
9.tip: Hozir o'ylab, hozir qaror qildingizmi? — will.
rules: will barcha shaxslarda bir xil, keyin to yo'q.
I'll = I will; won't = will not.
Oldindan rejalangan ish uchun going to.

10.def: will va going to ikkalasi kelajak haqida. will — hozir qabul qilingan qaror va shaxsiy fikr; going to — oldindan qilingan reja va ko'rinib turgan belgi.
uses: I'm going to visit my aunt on Sunday.
I think it will be fine.
Look out! The vase is going to fall.
forms: S + am / is / are + going to + V1
We're going to paint the house.
10.tip: «Buni qachon o'yladim?» Hozir — will. Oldin — going to.
rules: Qo'ng'iroq yoki eshik taqillashiga javob: I'll get it.
Belgi ko'z oldingizda bo'lsa — going to.
I think / I don't think bilan ko'proq will.
ex: There is no milk. I'll buy some.
I know. I'm going to buy some after work.
She's going to have a baby.
err: The phone is ringing. I'm going to answer.
The phone is ringing. I'll answer.
Look at that car! It will crash!
Look at that car! It's going to crash!

11.def: Present Continuous kelajak uchun ham ishlatiladi: vaqti va joyi KELISHIB QO'YILGAN reja, ya'ni kundalik daftaringizga yozilgan ish.
uses: Sotib olingan chipta, band qilingan joy
We are flying to Dubai on Friday.
forms: S + am / is / are + V-ing + kelasi vaqt
He is starting a new job on Monday.
S + am / is / are + not + V-ing
Am / Is / Are + S + V-ing + vaqt?
rules: Kelasi vaqt aytilmasa yoki kontekst bo'lmasa, «hozir» deb tushuniladi.
Ob-havo bashorati uchun ishlatilmaydi.
go bilan: I'm going to the cinema (going to go shart emas).
ex: We're having a party on Saturday.

12.def: Shall I…? va Shall we…? — taklif qilish va maslahat so'rash shakli: «qilib beraymi?», «qilamizmi?». Faqat I va we bilan ishlatiladi.
12.tip: Shall I? = «Xohlasangiz men qilaman». Shall we? = «Keling, qilamizmi?»
rules: he, she, you, they bilan Shall ishlatilmaydi.
Javobga Yes, I shall deyilmaydi: Yes, please.
Let's go, shall we? — taklifni yumshatadi.
ex: Shall we go for a walk?

13.def: must va have to — majburiyat: «kerak», «shart». must — ko'proq gapiruvchining o'z qat'iy fikri; have to — tashqi qoida yoki sharoit talabi.
uses: I have to wear a uniform.
forms: She has to get up early.
Do / Does + S + have to + V1?
13.tip: Ichki ovoz — must. Tashqi qoida — have to.
rules: must o'zgarmaydi va keyin to qo'yilmaydi.
must ning o'tgan zamoni yo'q — had to.
Savolda odatda have to: Do I have to…?
ex: Uning tug'ilgan kunini eslab qolishim shart.
He has to take this medicine.

14.def: Bu ikkisi mutlaqo boshqa ma'noda! mustn't — TAQIQ: «mumkin emas». don't have to — majburiyat yo'q: «shart emas, xohlasang qil».
uses: didn't have to: o'tmishda shart bo'lmagan
forms: Shart emas — I, you, we, they
She doesn't have to work today.
14.tip: mustn't — qizil chiroq. don't have to — sariq: o'zing hal qil.
rules: mustn't dan keyin to yo'q.
needn't = don't have to.
Taqiq uchun can't ham ishlatiladi.
ex: You mustn't use your phone in the exam.
It's Sunday, so I don't have to get up early.
He doesn't have to wear a tie.
err: Entry is free; you mustn't pay.
Entry is free; you don't have to pay.

15.def: should — maslahat va tavsiya: «qilgani ma'qul», «qilishing kerak (menimcha)». must dan yumshoqroq: tanlov tinglovchida qoladi.
uses: You shouldn't eat so much sugar.
forms: I think / I don't think + S + should + V1
I don't think you should go.
rules: should barcha shaxslarda bir xil, to'siz.
«Bormasliging kerak» deb o'ylasam: I don't think you should go.
ought to = should.

16.def: might va may — EHTIMOL: «balki», «mumkin». Aniq bilmaganda ishlatiladi. may rasmiy ruxsat so'rashda ham keladi.
forms: S + might not / may not + V1
rules: might va may dan keyin to yo'q.
he / she / it bilan -s olmaydi.
maybe — bitta so'z, ravish; may be — ikki so'z, fe'l.
ex: We might go to the park.
Take a coat. It may be cold.

17.def: So do I («men ham») va Neither do I («men ham … emas») — suhbatdosh gapiga qo'shilish. Gapdagi yordamchi fe'l takrorlanadi va egadan oldin turadi.
uses: I like tea. So do I.
I can't swim. Neither can I.
I like tea. Oh, I don't.
forms: I haven't seen it. Neither have I.
be → am ; Present Simple → do ; Past Simple → did
I went home. So did we.
17.tip: Eshitgan gapdagi «yordamchi»ni oling va tartibni teskari qiling.
rules: Fe'l egadan OLDIN: So do I (So I do emas).
Neither bilan fe'l darak shaklida (qo'sh inkor yo'q).
Gapda can, will, have bo'lsa, o'shani takrorlang.
ex: I don't smoke. Neither do I.
She can drive. So can her brother.
U mashina hayday oladi. Akasi ham.
err: I like it. So I do.
I like it. So do I.
I don't know. So do I.
I don't know. Neither do I.
I was there. So did I.
I was there. So was I.

18.def: Ichki savol — savolni muloyim iboraning ICHIGA joylash: «Bilmaysizmi, … qayerda?». Ichki qismda savol tartibi emas, DARAK tartibi ishlatiladi.
uses: Do you know where the bank is?
Could you tell me what time it is?
Do you know if the shop is open?
forms: Do you know + wh-so'z + S + V?
Do you know where he lives?
Could you tell me + wh-so'z + S + V?
Could you tell me when the train leaves?
Do you know + if / whether + S + V?
Do you know if she is here?
18.tip: Ichkariga kirgan savol «tinchlanadi»: do / does / did yo'qoladi.
rules: where is the bank → where the bank is.
does he live → he lives (-s qaytadi).
did he go → he went.
ex: Do you know what this word means?
Could you tell me where the toilets are?
I don't know why she left.
err: Do you know where is the station?
Do you know where the station is?
Can you tell me what does it cost?
Can you tell me what it costs?
Do you know is he at home?
Do you know if he is at home?

19.def: Sifat (adjective) OTNI tasvirlaydi: qanday? Ravish (adverb) FE'LNI tasvirlaydi: qanday qilib? Ko'p ravishlar sifatga -ly qo'shib yasaladi.
rules: look, feel, smell, taste, sound dan keyin sifat: It smells good.
friendly va lovely — sifat, ravish emas.
hard va hardly ma'nosi boshqa.

20.def: Qiyosiy daraja ikki narsani solishtiradi: «…roq», «…dan ko'ra». Qisqa sifatlarga -er qo'shiladi, uzunlarining oldidan more qo'yiladi.
uses: A car is faster than a bike.
forms: This test is easier than the last one.
A city is bigger than a village.
good → better ; bad → worse ; far → farther
My phone is better than yours.
rules: 2 bo'g'inli y bilan tugasa -er: happier.
more va -er birga ishlatilmaydi.
very emas, much: much bigger.
ex: English is more useful than I thought.
Her test was worse than mine.

21.def: Orttirma daraja — guruhdagi ENG yuqori narsa: «eng …». Doim the bilan keladi.
uses: He is the tallest in the class.
It's the best film I have ever seen.
Tashkent is one of the biggest cities.
forms: good → the best ; bad → the worst ; far → the farthest
one of the + orttirma + ko'plik ot
21.tip: Ikkita — -er than. Uch va undan ko'p — the -est.
rules: Joy bilan in, davr bilan of: in the city, of the year.
one of dan keyin ot ko'plikda.
my, his kelsa the tushadi: my best friend.
ex: This is the cheapest shop here.
Bu shu yerdagi eng arzon do'kon.
What is the most difficult subject?
It was the worst day of my life.

22.def: as … as — ikki narsa TENG ekanini bildiradi: «…chalik». not as … as esa teng emasligini: «…chalik emas».
uses: She is as tall as her mother.
This bag is not as heavy as that one.
My car is the same as yours.
forms: not as easy as it looks
Your shirt is different from mine.
rules: as … as orasida sifat oddiy shaklda (-er emas).
the same as (the same like emas).
A is not as old as B = B is older than A.
ex: I'm not as busy as last week.
He runs as fast as his brother.
Her phone is the same as mine.

23.def: too — «haddan tashqari» (muammo bor), enough — «yetarlicha». Joylashuvi muhim: too sifatdan oldin, enough esa sifatdan keyin, otdan oldin.
uses: too: me'yordan ortiq, shuning uchun bo'lmaydi
The tea is too hot to drink.
He is old enough to drive.
23.tip: too — oldinda yuradi, enough — sifatning orqasidan.
rules: too ijobiy «juda» emas — muammoni bildiradi (juda = very).
Kim uchun: too heavy for me to carry.
enough ot bilan oldin, sifat bilan keyin.
ex: It's too cold to go out.

24.def: Ikkinchi fe'l qanday shaklda kelishi birinchi fe'lga bog'liq: ba'zilaridan keyin -ing, ba'zilaridan keyin to + V1 keladi.
forms: enjoy / like / love / hate / finish / stop / mind / keep + V-ing
want / need / decide / hope / plan / learn / promise + to + V1
24.tip: Kelajakka qarasa (want, hope, plan) — to. Zavq yoki tajriba (enjoy, hate) — -ing.
rules: like va love dan keyin to ham bo'ladi, farqi kichik.
would like / would love dan keyin faqat to.
look forward to dan keyin -ing.
